about_the_game:
SUMMARY

Welcome, misfit babies, to Wittle Misfits—a multiplayer mayhem-filled game of trust, betrayal, and big baby energy.

Mother has let you out of the crib… but not for long. Trapped in a colorful testing facility disguised as a daycare, 4 to 6 babies must complete ridiculous minigames before time runs out. The only catch? One of you is secretly an Evil Baby, working against the group. And they don’t even know it—yet.

With built-in voice chat, it's up to you to talk, cry, crawl, and chaos your way through each trial. Whether you're hurling toys across the room, racing through foam-filled ball pits, or working together to solve puzzles, every round is a ticking time bomb of laughter, sabotage, and baby-brained brilliance.

Are you ready to escape the nursery—or will your "friends" leave you behind in a pool of your own drool?

GAMEPLAY

Wittle Misfits is a 4–6 player first-person baby party game, combining the frantic energy of co-op minigames with the suspense of a hidden traitor. Each match cycles through different daycare-inspired rooms where you and your fellow babies must:

  • Complete wacky objectives before time runs out

  • Use voice chat to coordinate (or deceive)

  • Avoid deadly toys and traps

  • Figure out who the Evil Baby is—before it's too late

Each baby is assigned tasks, but the Evil Baby’s presence means every game can descend into pure chaos. The twist? Even the Evil Baby starts unaware of their role… until it’s activated mid-match.

KEY FEATURES

👶 First-Person Baby Mayhem
Waddle, crawl, and yeet plush toys in a whimsical world built from a toddler’s-eye view.

🎭 One Baby is Evil... But Doesn't Know It (Yet)
Inspired by hidden role games like Among Us, Wittle Misfits adds a baby-brained twist—where even the traitor starts off innocent.

🎤 Built-In Voice Chat
Talk (or scream) your way through the chaos. Bluffing, blaming, and bargaining are all part of the fun.

🧩 Surprising Minigames
Each room brings a new twist—work together to escape, or work alone to survive.

🎨 A Colorful, Surreal World
Like if Fall Guys, Baby’s Day Out, and Inside had a sippy-cup-fueled fever dream together.

ABOUT US

At Rockfire Games, we believe the dumbest ideas are sometimes the best ones. Wittle Misfits is our twisted tribute to friendship, betrayal, and baby violence. We hope you laugh, scream, and maybe cry a little. Just like a real baby.

content_descriptors.notes: Some depictions of violence and death, dark comedy themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Wittle Misfits is a chaotic 4–6 player baby party game where one baby is secretly evil. Complete minigames, survive the daycare, and use voice chat to outwit your friends—before nap time turns deadly.
